# HELD (false-positive fix): arithmetic in prose is prose

- type: Craft
- domain: solo-operator venture dashboard
- user: owner scanning a threshold column
- platform: desktop
- problem: a gate that rejects correct work trains authors to pad
- confidence: medium
- outcome: unknown
- source: fixture — adversarial pass round 2, library lint

## Principle

Keep runway < twelve months visible and margin > forty percent on the row, because a threshold
the reader has to open an item to see is a threshold nobody checks while scanning.

## Do not copy

Do not lift the < and > thresholds themselves; the comparison operators here are sentence
punctuation and the numbers belong to whatever the surface actually measures.
